name: Ondo OUSG
oneLiner: OUSG is Ondo's tokenized Treasury-fund portfolio; a NAV-accreting share (not $1-pegged) limited to eligible qualified purchasers.
collateral: Diversified fund portfolio comprising State Street Galaxy SWEEP, BlackRock BUIDL, Franklin BENJI and Fidelity FYOXX, plus USDC at Coinbase, bank deposits and funds in transit/net receivables; issuer publishes dated position values.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting fund share token (not pegged to $1); token price rises daily as Treasury income accrues; instant mint/redemption at daily NAV via OUSGInstantManager against USDC (T+0 settlement via BUIDL on-chain liquidity); token transfers restricted to KYC-verified whitelisted addresses on-chain

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Ondo's OUSG product and portfolio disclosures support the tokenized Treasury-fund share classification, but do not disclose a current OUSG-specific loss-recovery design for underlying fund and custody failure.

proofOfReserves.provider: BPM LLP (Ondo I LP auditor named in Ondo Capital Management LLC's May 13, 2026 Form ADV, Schedule D 7.B.(1); NAV Consulting is the separate fund administrator)

jurisdiction.license: Reg D Rule 506(c); Section 3(c)(7) exemption; restricted to accredited investors who are Qualified Purchasers

listingStatusReview.reason: Qualified-purchaser NAV-accreting Treasury fund-of-funds share, not a fixed-par stablecoin; no active stablecoin links it as reserve backing (listing policy 2.0).
